name: Wild Healing (Racial)
body:
Vestiges of your lycanthropic resilience awaken, allowing you to supernaturally heal your injuries.

Prerequisites: Con 13, Cha 13, base Fortitude save +2, skinwalker.

Benefit: While you are in bestial form, as a standard action, you can heal a number of hit points equal to ½ your character level + your Charisma bonus + your Constitution bonus. You can use this ability once per day, and using it leaves you fatigued for 1 minute.

Editor’s Note

If you are using the skinwalker’s original change shape ability, use the following instead:

Benefit: Once per day, you can expend 2 uses of your skinwalker change shape ability to heal a number of hit points equal to ½ your character level + your Charisma bonus + your Constitution bonus. Using this ability leaves you fatigued for 1 minute.
